title: Ninapochoka kwa urahisi kabla ya mchana, labda nina baridi kidogo

text.When I get tired easily before noon, may: Ninapochoka kwa urahisi kabla ya mchana, labda nina baridi kidogo
text.Tired lately. Sleepy before noon, alread: Imechoka hivi majuzi. Kulala kabla ya saa sita mchana, tayari.
text.If that's you, maybe you're just cold 🐧: Ikiwa ni wewe, labda wewe ni baridi tu 🐧
text.Simple principle. A little cold makes pe: Kanuni rahisi. Baridi kidogo huwafanya watu wasinzie.
text.Your body starts spending energy on stay: Mwili wako unaanza kutumia nguvu zako kuwa joto. Huo ndio uchovu.
text.In Malaysia, I finally understood that a: Nchini Malaysia, hatimaye nilielewa kuwa kuuliza watu ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi
text.Thank you to the air conditioner: thanks: Asante kwa kiyoyozi: shukrani kwa hilo, naweza kulala kwa raha
